$schema: model-router example — copy to model-router.json and edit; never commit real keys
comment: The router tries entries in order and falls back on failure or limit. Paid entries are used ONLY if you list them yourself. Free limits are real and pooled, not limitless: OpenRouter :free is 20 req/min, 50/day, 1000/day after $10 lifetime purchases; Gemini and Groq free tiers have their own per-model caps (check their consoles); Ollama local has no meter, limited by your hardware. See docs/FREE-MODELS.md. rank = strength tier for THAT task (1 = strongest in this config for this task, 3 = weakest fallback), judged on public benchmark results and task capability — not on fame. A lesser-known model can outrank a famous one for a specific task.

groq_free.note: per-model rate limits — check the Groq console for current numbers

chat.note: Groq free tier — fast fallback, own per-model caps
Gemini free tier — check current quota in AI Studio

code.note: local, no meter — limited by your hardware
fallback only; counts against the 50/day free limit

phone.note: Artemis needs its own multimodal model key; see docs/ARTEMIS.md

vision.note: Gemini free tier — check current quota in AI Studio
Groq free tier — only if the model supports vision
